scope: Declared serial graph mutation reservations across resident handoffs
implementation: Freeze the original scope and reserve declared action counts across accepted successors; do not reset reservations when loading the successor graph.
Reject successor reservations exceeding original world or inventory limits, expanding block IDs, or expanding bounded regions.
Exact already-queued replay returns before reservation; rejected reservations do not consume budget. Cancellation does not refund uncertain reservations.

verification.positive: Successive reservations fit until the original declared ceiling is exhausted; a rejected oversized request leaves room for a smaller one.
verification.negative: Over-budget counts, unbounded region expansion, and negative/fractional declarations are rejected.

limitations: Reservations mirror declared counts, not proven physical maxima. Crafting output batches and incidental pickup need effect-time verification.
No live GameTest, production advertisement, deployment, or packaged EXE build.
This is not acceptance of the complete ET6 capacity or mutation-safety lifecycle.
